After: /s/demo/no, /s/demo/no/om-oss and the blog routes are 'static', and one Add to cart is 1 request with an answer under 5,000 bytes.

commits.title: One per-visitor answer for a store page: /api/shop/mine, asked only when the marker says so

changes.how: Model it line for line on src/app/api/shop/tiles/route.ts: `export async function GET(request: Request)`, first `await connection()`, then `if (!sameSite(request)) return fail(403, ...)`, read `store` and `market` from the query string, 400 when either is missing. Resolve with `resolveShop(store, market)` from `@/server/shop` (not resolveSellingShop: a website with several countries still gets its hint); 404 when null or when `await lockedOut(shop.store)`. Answer `Response.json({ cart, saved, hint }, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" } })` where: `cart` is `await getCartCount({ storeId: shop.store.id, market: shop.market })` and `saved` is `await savedProductIds(shop.store.id)` (from `@/server/wishlists`), both only when `featureOn(shop.store, "shop")`, else 0 and []. `hint` is null when `shop.store.markets.length <= 1`; otherwise build it exactly as src/components/country-hint-section.tsx lines 18-32 do today: null when `isBot(request.headers.get("user-agent"))`; `hintCountry(request.headers.get("x-vercel-ip-country"), market.code, store.markets.map((m) => m.code))`; find the target market; the region name through `Intl.DisplayNames([market.locale, "en"], { type: "region" })`; and return `{ fromBase: marketPath(store.slug, market.slug), toBase: marketLink(store.slug, market.slug, target.slug), lang: market.lang, words: { offer: words.offer(name), go: words.go(name), close: words.close, label: words.label } }`. Do not delete the marker cookie here or anywhere (step 0.15: a stale marker only costs this one small request). Add `import "server-only"` only if the tiles route has it. /api addresses are outside the proxy's matcher (src/proxy.ts), so no proxy change.

In `setCartCookie()` (about line 717), after the cart cookie is set, add `await markMine(shop.storeId);`. `markMine(storeId)` and `mineCookieName(storeId)` are exported from src/server/wishlists.ts by step 0.15 (the marker cookie `kaizen_mine_{storeId}`: value 1, not httpOnly, sameSite lax, path /). If importing src/server/wishlists.ts into cart.ts makes an import cycle (the type check or the build says so), move the two exports unchanged to a new file src/server/mine-marker.ts and import them from there in wishlists.ts, cart.ts and customers.ts. The cart id itself stays httpOnly (D14).

Where the customer's session cookie is set (about line 416, `(await cookies()).set(cookieName(storeId), token, {`), call `await markMine(storeId)` right after, unless step 0.15 already does (`rg -n markMine src/server/customers.ts`), so a signed-in shopper's page asks for their own answer.

In `KNOWN_COOKIES`, find the entry of the marker `kaizen_mine_…` that step 0.15 added (category `necessary`, `on: "store"`). Rewrite its four purposes (en, nb, sv, da) to say: remembers that this browser has a cart, saved products or a sign-in in this store, so pages ask for them only then; it holds no identifier. If its `feature` limits it to the wishlist, widen it to `shop`. Keep the pattern and the days.

A `"use client"` module grown from the store at the top of src/components/wishlist-heart.tsx (lines 12-41). Module-level state `{ cart: number | null, saved: Set<string> | null, hint: Hint | null }` with one `listeners` set and `subscribe`. Export: `loadOwn({ store, market, storeId, hinted }: { store: string; market: string; storeId: string; hinted: boolean })`, which runs once per document (a module flag keyed by store and market), and fetches `/api/shop/mine?store=...&market=...` with `{ cache: "no-store" }` only when `document.cookie` holds `kaizen_mine_` + storeId (the name `mineCookieName()` gives on the server) or `hinted` is true; otherwise it sets `cart: 0, saved: new Set(), hint: null` without a request. Export `setCart(n: number)`, `setSaved(ids: string[])`, and the hooks `useCart(): number | null`, `useSaved(): Set<string> | null`, `useHint(): Hint | null`, each on `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getter, () => null)`. Import nothing from `@/server`, no zod, no `@/lib/i18n` (src/lib/storefront-bundle.scan.test.ts holds this).

Remove the module's own `saved`, `loading`, `listeners`, `setSaved`, `load`, `subscribe` and `useSaved` (lines 12-41) and import `useSaved`, `setSaved` and `loadOwn` from `./shopper-own`. Each heart and the wishlist count call `loadOwn(...)` in an effect with the props they already have (store slug, market slug) plus the store's id; if a heart does not have the store's id as a prop, add `storeId` to its props and pass it from each caller (`rg -n "<WishlistHeart|<WishlistCount" src`). The toggle action keeps returning the list and calling `setSaved`. The fetch of `${base}/wishlist/saved` goes; keep the route file src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/wishlist/saved/route.ts for this deploy (open pages still call it).

Add: a cold load of /s/demo/no with no cookies makes no request whose URL contains `/api/shop/mine` or `/wishlist/saved` in the 3 s after load; after saving a product and a reload, exactly one request to `/api/shop/mine` is made, the heart is pressed and the count shows 1. Keep step 0.15's assertions.

changes.how: Split in two. Create the client part in a new file (next change).

`"use client"`. Export `CartLink({ storeId, storeSlug, market, variant, words })` that calls `loadOwn({ store: storeSlug, market: market.slug, storeId, hinted })` in an effect, reads `const count = useCart() ?? 0`, and draws the same markup as `CartLinkShell` with that count. The accessible name must be exactly today's: `words.cartCount(count)` (`Handlekurv (2)`) when count > 0, else `words.cart`: about twenty e2e assertions read it. Per D212 a visitor's client component reads its words from the browser files: add `cart` and `cartCount` to src/lib/messages/nb-browser.ts, sv-browser.ts, da-browser.ts and en-browser.ts (copy the strings from nb.ts lines 656-657 and the same keys in sv.ts, da.ts, en.ts) and read them the way the other client components in src/components read `browserText()` (open src/components/add-to-cart.tsx's caller for the pattern; if function-valued words cannot cross from server to client, the browser files are the only source).

At about lines 286-288 and 582-584 replace `<Suspense fallback={<CartLinkShell .../>}><CartLink .../></Suspense>` with the client `<CartLink .../>` from `./cart-link-live` and no Suspense (same props; add `variant="bar"` on the second as today).
At about lines 178-180 do the same replacement for the builder-made header's cart link.

Replace the block `{store.markets.length > 1 && (<Suspense fallback={null}><OffPayRoutes><CountryHintSection store={store} market={market} /></OffPayRoutes></Suspense>)}` with `{store.markets.length > 1 && (<OffPayRoutes><CountryHintSlot store={store.slug} market={market.slug} storeId={store.id} /></OffPayRoutes>)}`. `"use client"`. `CountryHintSlot({ store, market, storeId })` calls `loadOwn({ store, market, storeId, hinted: true })` in an effect, reads `useHint()` and, when it is not null, renders the existing lazy `CountryHint` from `./lazy/country-hint` with the hint's `fromBase`, `toBase`, `lang` and `words`. Nothing else.
Delete once nothing imports it (`rg -n country-hint-section src` prints nothing). Its logic now lives in the mine route.

`"use client"`. `CartCountSeed({ count }: { count: number })` calls `setCart(count)` from `./shopper-own` in an effect that depends on `count`, and renders null. Draw it from the pages that already render per request and show or change the cart, so the badge is right without a call: src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/cart/cart-contents.tsx (it holds the lines: pass the units as getCartCount counts them, quantity for goods and 1 for a booking line), the wishlist section (src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/wishlist/wishlist-section.tsx) and the account's catalogue page. Their actions keep `refresh()`, which redraws the seed.

Path as of today; after step 2.2 the file is under `src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/` with the same name: edit it there. In this commit only add the count to the answer; `refresh()` stays. Add `count?: number` to the `AddToCartState` type. In `addToCart`, before the final return, `const count = await getCartCount(input.shop);` and add `count` to both returned objects.

In `useOpenCartAfterAdd(enabled, cartHref, outcome)` widen the third parameter's type to `{ outcome: string; count?: number }` and, inside the effect right after `seen.current = outcome;` and before the `enabled` test, add `if (typeof outcome.count === "number") setCart(outcome.count);` (import `setCart` from `./shopper-own`). All five add forms call this hook (add-to-cart.tsx, product-bar.tsx, gift-card-buy.tsx, appointment-picker.tsx, range-picker.tsx), so none of them changes.

changes.how: Path as of today; after step 2.2 the file is under `src/app/s/[store]/[market]/(shop)/` with the same name: edit it there. This is the part that needs judgement.
